Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.translation: Bokstäverna växlar: linje, mellanrum, linje, mellanrum.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
rows.translation: G-klaven slingrar sig runt andra linjen nedifrån. Den linjen är G ovanför ettstrukna C. Högre instrument och röster läser den.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
rows.translation: Vilken ton ligger på andra linjen i G-klaven?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
rows.translation: G-klaven slingrar sig runt den linjen för att markera G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Nedifrån och upp är G-klavens linjer E, G, B, D, F. Minns dem som En Glad Björn Dansar Fint.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Nedersta linjen är E, som En i En Glad Björn Dansar Fint.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Mittlinjen är B, som Björn i En Glad Björn Dansar Fint.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Översta linjen är F, som Fint i En Glad Björn Dansar Fint.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.translation: Fjärde linjen upp är D, som Dansar i En Glad Björn Dansar Fint.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung de tre nedersta linjerna: E, G, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.translation: G-klavens fyra mellanrum bildar ett engelskt ord nedifrån och upp: F, A, C, E. Mellanrummen stavar FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Nedersta mellanrummet är F, första bokstaven i FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.translation: Tredje mellanrummet upp är C: F, A, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.translation: Andra mellanrummet upp är A: F, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
rows.translation: Sätt ihop dem så stiger notsystemet E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: linje, mellanrum, linje, mellanrum hela vägen upp.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.translation: Översta mellanrummet är E, sista bokstaven i FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.translation: Andra linjen upp är G, där G-klaven slingrar sig.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung mellanrummen nedifrån och upp: F, A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.translation: När en ton går över eller under systemet förlängs det med korta hjälplinjer. Ettstrukna C ligger på en hjälplinje precis under G-klavens system.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.translation: En hjälplinje under G-klavens system är ettstrukna C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.translation: D hänger i mellanrummet precis under nedersta linjen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.translation: Ovanför översta linjen fortsätter mönstret. G ligger precis över översta linjen och A på första hjälplinjen ovanför.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.translation: En hjälplinje över G-klavens system är A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.translation: Räkna ned: ettstrukna C på första hjälplinjen, B under, A på andra hjälplinjen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.translation: Spela eller sjung ettstrukna C, sedan D och E, från hjälplinjen upp på notsystemet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
